Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing creation of a retired active license for mental health professionals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the creation of a retired active license formental health professionals; and adding a new section to chapter 18.225RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.225 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary of the department of health shall promulgate rulesrelating to issuance of a retired active license under RCW 18.130.250for mental health counselors, marriage and family therapists, advancedsocial workers, and independent clinical social workers, which providethat an applicant for a retired active license must hold an activelicense in good standing or have held an active license in goodstanding that expired less than five years prior to the date ofapplication for the retired active license.
